guestPolicy: Guests may stay no more than 3 nights per month without written consent; unauthorized occupants are charged $25 per day.
maintenanceResponsibility: Tenant accepts the unit as is and pays for all repairs to the unit and appliances regardless of cause, except roof and foundation.
earlyTerminationPenalty: Three months of rent plus rent owed until the landlord recovers possession.

otherMoneyTerms.name: Daily late charge
otherMoneyTerms.notes: Per day after the 1st, up to $450 per month

otherMoneyTerms.name: Pet rent
otherMoneyTerms.notes: Per pet per month, if approved

otherMoneyTerms.name: Renters insurance
otherMoneyTerms.notes: At least $100,000 liability, landlord named as additional insured

otherMoneyTerms.name: Attorney fees
otherMoneyTerms.notes: Tenant pays landlord's attorney fees in any dispute

rawNotes: Tenant waives claims against the landlord for property damage, including landlord negligence. Partial payments do not stop late charges.
